title: Syncing property filter operators between Rust and Django
answers: Where are feature flag operators defined in Rust and Python?
How do I add a new property filter operator to feature flags?
What files must change when adding a feature flag evaluation operator?
body:
When adding or modifying feature flag property filter operators:
1. Add the enum variant in `rust/feature-flags/src/properties/property_models.rs:OperatorType`.
2. Implement evaluation matching in `rust/feature-flags/src/properties/property_matching.rs`.
3. Add the operator to `FEATURE_FLAG_SUPPORTED_OPERATORS` in `products/feature_flags/backend/api/filters_schema.py`.
4. Update the write-path serde guard in `products/feature_flags/backend/models/feature_flag.py`.
`OperatorType` is intentionally a superset; failing to sync with Python allows the UI/API to save operators that fail or reject on evaluation/write.
applies: When adding, removing, or modifying feature flag property filter operators. Does not apply to event filters or cohort-only operators.
says: Feature flag targeting rules fail evaluation when using newly introduced filter operators
Saving a feature flag with a new matching operator gives validation error
New property filter conditions configured in the web interface are ignored during evaluation
